name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: Clawd's office, image thumbnails in the terminal, a remote terminal, a live preview of what Claude builds (web, mobile, desktop, game), session recap, secret masking

plugins.name: clawd
plugins.description: Clawd's HQ: Clawd lives in a pixel art office and mimes what Claude does, with a game HUD (model, context, rate limits), menus and interactions

plugins.name: vignettes
plugins.description: Thumbnails in the terminal of the images Claude reads or shares (Read, SendUserFile, MCP screenshots), and a /gallery view on every screen

plugins.name: terminal-distant
plugins.description: A terminal in a panel: from the desktop client, VS Code or your phone in Remote Control, run commands on the session's machine and attach the output to your next message

plugins.name: apercu
plugins.description: What Claude is building (website, mobile app, desktop client, Unity game…), live in a panel of the client (desktop, mobile in Remote Control, terminal): Claude hooks up the project and the network bridge itself, and drives the same target as you

plugins.name: recap
plugins.description: /recap: a summary of the session (done, in progress, left) in a panel, ready to paste into a log

plugins.name: masque-secrets
plugins.description: Masks the values from ~/.claude/secrets/*.env in everything the model reads
